item.cobblemon.booster_energy.tooltip_1: Raises the power of Pokémon with the Protosynthesis or Quark Drive abilities.
item.cobblemon.soul_dew.tooltip_1: Raises the power of Latios and Latias's Psychic- or Dragon-type moves.
item.cobblemon.clear_amulet.tooltip: While held, the holder's stats cannot be lowered by an opponent's moves or abilities.
item.cobblemon.sword_ball.tooltip: Catch rate scales 0.5–4x with the sum of the Pokémon's Attack and Special Attack.
item.cobblemon.shield_ball.tooltip: Catch rate scales 0.5–4x with the sum of the Pokémon's Defense and Special Defense.
item.cobblemon.skull_ball.tooltip: 3.5x catch rate in the Skull Cavern.
item.cobblemon.blossom_ball.tooltip: 0.5x catch rate. Caught Pokémon become Shiny.
item.cobblemon.prismatic_ball.tooltip: 4.5x catch rate against Shiny Pokémon. 3x catch rate against all other Pokémon.
